ld.description: Mild By Nature, Sierra Bees Anti-Bug Balm Stick Formulated with Natural Ingredients for Bug Defense Featuring Beeswax and Botanicals USDA Organic & Certified by Oregon Tilth No Gluten or GMOs No Sulfates, Preservatives or Phthalates Cruelty-Free & No Animal Testing Nature's Choice for Soft and Soothing Skincare Key Ingredients Beeswax Shea Butter, Olive & Castor Oil Citronella and Lemongrass Oil Cedarwood, Geranium & Rosemary Oil We all love spending time outside, but pesky bugs can quickly ruin your outdoor fun. You don’t have to let these insects drive you inside. All you need is the proper defense to help keep bugs at bay. Mild By Nature, Sierra Bees Anti-Bug Balm Stick provides a convenient way to protect yourself from biting insects and other annoying bugs. It’s formulated with citronella, beeswax and botanical oils to provide defense from pests without the strong scent of bug spray. Simply apply the balm to any area of the skin.
